title: Configure sympa
description: Configure the Sympa mailing list manager

host.description: Host name of the web interface, like 'sympa.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

list_domain.description: Mail domain of the lists, like 'example.org' for 'mylist@example.org'

listmasters.description: Email addresses of the Sympa administrators

mail_server.description: UUID of the mail module instance that receives the list mail

user_domain.description: User domain for the web login, empty to use only Sympa accounts

default_lang.description: Default language of Sympa, like 'en-US' or 'fr'
